data.body:
[P2] Preserve non-retryable control failures through invocation cleanup

If a processor raises `SystemExit` or `KeyboardInterrupt` during a virtual child's normal terminal hook, this branch re-raises while leaving the completion pending. Core then invokes invocation End during exception cleanup. Its fresh `InvocationFinalization` has no record of the control failure, so it recreates and exports the same span again. Invocation view has the same path. Track non-retryable failures for the whole invocation and exclude them from subsequent drains; add a public virtual-child regression asserting one processor attempt and propagation of the original control exception.
